title: Refuse an oversized task-sync candidate document before pruning or staging a preparation generation
outcome: Refuse an oversized task-sync candidate document before pruning or staging a preparation generation
acceptance: Preparation refuses a candidate that exceeds the task candidate limits write_documents enforces (per-file, task count, total bytes), such as an include_notes task whose inline notes serialize past the per-file limit, before journal::publish prunes the predecessor generation or creates a staging directory.

An owned regression seeds two completed generations, prepares an oversized inline-notes task, asserts the refusal, asserts the progress directory listing and bytes are unchanged, and shows the predecessor generation is still readable by read_prepared.
